catalog.write_api: controlled versioned import only; no direct UI or public-menu writes; imported raw data does not approve sale
catalog.operational_boundary: catalog reads may opt into the PG adapter in isolated staging; POS orders, seats, payments and existing price snapshots continue using the existing SQLite operational store
